oracle.coarse: For each commit, ground truth = every Test* function in a package (internal-test or external-test variant) whose go-list -deps -test transitive import closure includes a changed package (or IS the changed package) at that commit; selection = `fathom tests select --since <parent>` run against a scratch store ingested from that commit's checked-out tree; recall = |selected ∩ truth| / |truth| per commit.
oracle.finer: On a sample of commits (smallest coarse-truth sets, capped at 40 candidates per commit prioritizing fathom's own selected tests), narrows truth to only those candidates whose OWN isolated run (`go test -run '^Name$' -coverpkg=<changed packages> -coverprofile`) actually covers a line git diff -U0 shows as added/modified in a changed file at that commit.
oracle.time_fraction: sum of the FULL recorded elapsed time (from one `go test ./... -count=1 -json` run at HEAD, no -race) of every package `tests select` names in its invocations, divided by the sum of every package's elapsed time in that same run (a serial-equivalent full-suite duration) — package granularity, not per-selected-function, matching what `go test -run` still has to build and start.
